correction.fix: For a>=1, use h1*(a-1)/2 + (h2+1)*a/2 <= (n+1)*alpha for envelope CRC; standard CRC similarly uses h1*(a-1)/2 + h2*a/2 + 1.
correction.consequence: All reported exact baseline and recertification figures below supersede the earlier PR draft artifact.

protocol.validity: for every augmented q, sum_c q[c]*ell_c(A(q-e_c)) <= (n+1)*alpha
